description: CI runtime optimizations. The council audit measured CI over 30 days. Each change runs the same checks on the PR, on the `development` push, on the `main` push, and in Release. The repository is public, so the cost is runner capacity and wait time.

userStories.title: Release reuses the CI: Harness workflow
userStories.description: As the operator, I want `release.yml` to call `ci-harness.yml` so that one definition gates both PRs and releases.
acceptanceCriteria: `ci-harness.yml` declares `workflow_call` in its `on:` block.
`ci-harness.yml` lists `development` as its only push branch. The list does not contain `main`.
The `ci-harness.yml` path filters for `push` and `pull_request` contain `.github/workflows/release.yml`.
`release.yml` has no `validate` job body and no `boot-lint` job body. One job runs `uses: ./.github/workflows/ci-harness.yml`.
The `reserve` job in `release.yml` needs the job that calls `ci-harness.yml`.
When `release.yml` calls `ci-harness.yml`, the concurrency group expression resolves to a value that contains `github.run_id`. Two release runs on `main` do not cancel each other.
When a PR or a `development` push starts `ci-harness.yml`, the concurrency group stays `ci-harness-${{ github.ref }}` with `cancel-in-progress: true`.
The README badge for `ci-harness.yml` uses `branch=development`.
`.agro/scripts/__tests__/release-reservation.test.ts` asserts the new `needs` list and the `uses:` line.
`pnpm test:scripts` exits 0.

userStories.title: Remove main pushes and narrow the Boot Guard path filter
userStories.description: As the operator, I want Boot Guard and Compatibility to skip `main` pushes and unrelated script changes so that they stop re-testing validated commits.
acceptanceCriteria: `sandbox-boot-guard.yml` and `sandbox-compatibility.yml` list `development` as their only push branch.

The `sandbox-boot-guard.yml` filters list each boot-path script by name in place of `.agro/scripts/**`. The list holds `docker-compose.sh`, `check-host-port.sh`, `paths.sh`, `provision-python.sh`, `sandbox-healthcheck.sh`, `sandbox-boot-smoke.sh`, `sandbox-upgrade-smoke.sh`, `cli-first-install-smoke.sh`, `verify-sandbox-image.sh`, `install.sh`, and `link-providers.sh`.
The `sandbox-boot-guard.yml` filters keep `.agro/cli/**` and exclude `.agro/cli/**/__tests__/**` and `.agro/cli/**/*.md` with `!` patterns.
The `ci-status` skill at `.agro/skills/ci-status/SKILL.md` lists the new Boot Guard filter.
`pnpm test:scripts` exits 0.
userStories.notes: 1 reasoned: boot-guard and compatibility push branches list only development (grep for '- main' returns 0). 2 reasoned: diff replaces .agro/scripts/** with the 11 named scripts in push and pull_request filters. 3 reasoned: .agro/cli/** kept, followed by !.agro/cli/**/__tests__/** and !.agro/cli/**/*.md. 4 reasoned: ci-status SKILL.md line lists the new filter. 5 executed: pnpm test:scripts on the integrated task branch, exit 0 (108 files, 2588 tests). Repair: sandbox-upgrade-smoke.test.ts added to owned paths to update a pinned glob.

userStories.title: Move the optional-harness install job off PR pushes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the optional-harness install job to run after merge so that my PR checks finish in about 2.5 minutes.
acceptanceCriteria: The `optional-harness-install` job in `sandbox-compatibility.yml` has `if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'`.
The `base-node-pnpm-parity` job still runs on `pull_request`.
The job step calls `agro harness list --json` one time and reads each harness `binary` from that output. Lines 100 and 143 no longer call the command twice.
The step still fails when the catalog declares no installable harness.
`pnpm test:scripts` exits 0.

userStories.title: Delete retired alias checks and unread variables
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want to delete checks that compare a value with itself so that each remaining check can fail.
acceptanceCriteria: The `publish-image` job in `release.yml` builds 2 tags plus the smoke tag, pushes 2 tags, and runs `agro --version` one time.
`release.yml` has no `oh_version` variable and no `Verify the agro and agro version tags share one digest` step.
`.agro/scripts/verify-release-aliases.sh` and `.agro/scripts/__tests__/verify-release-aliases.test.ts` do not exist.
`git grep -n verify-release-aliases` returns no line outside `CHANGELOG.md` and `.agro/tasks/`.
`.agro/skills/release/SKILL.md` and `.agro/scripts/README.md` name 2 GHCR tags and do not name `verify-release-aliases.sh`.
`sandbox-boot-guard.yml` has no `LEGACY_IMAGE` key.
`release-reservation.test.ts` asserts 2 `docker push` lines and no `oh_version`.
`pnpm test:scripts` exits 0.

userStories.title: Add job timeouts
userStories.description: As the operator, I want each CI job to have a timeout so that a registry stall cannot hold a runner for 360 minutes.
acceptanceCriteria: Each job in `ci-harness.yml`, `sandbox-boot-guard.yml`, `sandbox-compatibility.yml`, `release.yml`, `publish-cli.yml`, and `close-issues-on-development.yml` sets `timeout-minutes`.
Each value matches the table in Architectural Decisions.
A test in `.agro/scripts/__tests__/ci-workflow-contract.test.ts` fails when a job in `.github/workflows/` has no `timeout-minutes`.
`pnpm test:scripts` exits 0.
